crossRefs.note: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Reubenite chief during the reign of Jotham

translations.web: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
translations.bsb: His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,
translations.kjv: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy ➔ of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
translations.asv: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
